description_de: Minimalistischer Aquarell-Comic nach dem Styleguide «Visuelle Bibel» V1.2 (docs/BILDSTIL.md): warmweisses Papier, wenige dünne Linien, transparente Flächen, natürliche erwachsene Figuren, viel Weissraum. Gemalte Szenen je Bildfeld; Worte als Text darüber in der gewählten Sprache. Ersetzt in der App die Stile Symbol und Anime, wo vorhanden.

FIG-GRUPPE-DIENER.description_en: The servants: men and women of different ages in plain sand-coloured belted tunics with pale linen aprons, sleeves rolled up, bare-headed.

FIG-GRUPPE-JUENGER.description_en: The disciples: a few young and middle-aged men with beards in plain ochre and brown belted robes, bare-headed, staying close to Jesus.

FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE.description_en: Jewish people of Jerusalem: men, women and children of different ages in everyday robes in sand, grey, blue-grey and white, some with simple plain head coverings; dignified and varied, never caricatured or stereotyped.

FIG-JESUS.description_en: Jesus: a Galilean man in his early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, short full dark beard, warm brown eyes, olive skin, a kind and open face that is always fully visible like everyone else's; cream linen tunic and a muted terracotta-red mantle over one shoulder. No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.

FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU.description_en: Mary, the mother of Jesus: clearly one generation older than her adult son, grey streaks in her dark hair visible under the veil, gentle lines around eyes and mouth, slightly stooped posture; blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe.

FIG-OBJ-BECHER-VOLL.description_en: A simple earthenware cup with red wine.

FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WASSER.description_en: Six large stone water jars: waist-high, heavy, plain, pale grey, clearly distinct from small clay pitchers.

FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WEIN-LEER.description_en: A small empty clay wine jug.

FIG-OBJ-PEITSCHE.description_en: A short whip made of a few knotted cords.

FIG-ORT-TEMPEL.description_en: The temple in Jerusalem: tall pale limestone building and colonnades, drawn lightly.

FIG-ROLLE-BRAEUTIGAM.description_en: The bridegroom: a young beardless or lightly bearded man in a muted violet festive robe with a wreath of small fresh flowers on his head.

FIG-ROLLE-HAENDLER.description_en: Money changers and dove sellers: ordinary bearded men of different ages with simple striped headcloths, dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-ROLLE-SPEISEMEISTER.description_en: The master of the feast: a portly older man, grey beard, receding grey hair, bare-headed, in an olive-green robe with a wide ochre-gold belt.
